_comment: SYC-113 shared cookie vectors. Read by artifacts/cat-spotter/server/serve-web.test.ts and artifacts/api-server/src/middlewares/prelaunchGate.test.ts, so the website's and the API's copies of the cookie code can't drift apart. Keys are fixed test values, not secrets. Signature = base64url(HMAC-SHA256(key, String(expiry))), independently checked with Python's hmac module.
